authorizes: the comparator identity every pending SLURP cell pairs against from now on, and nothing else: no admission, no promotion, no superiority claim, no generalization claim, no test contact, no Stage-3 activity. No published verdict is reopened, restated or re-scored, and v1 stays a registered, resolvable scorer.
boundary: zero model, GPU, tool, embedding and network contacts. Every number is computed from outputs JSONL files that prior, separately-registered runs already sealed; gold enters only through the registered official scorer, on split_id='devel' with allow_heldout=False. No SLURP devel sentence text is read. The held-out test split is never named, loaded or scored.

verdict: RE-LOCKED. The closed-list direct baseline plus the SUCCESSOR legal-label projection slurp-legal-label-projection-v2 is the SLURP direct comparator: intent 73.10 against v1's locked 71.60 and the unprojected 71.40, scenario 82.60 from 81.00, action 74.60 from v1's 73.30 and back above the unprojected 73.90, SLU-F1 35.80 and every other entity-side number unchanged to the last decimal on every arm, impossible (scenario, action) pairs 3.90 percent to 0.00 percent. Every preregistered lock condition is met in BOTH contrasts: intent +1.50 pp over the locked comparator (15 saves, 0 harms, CI90 [1.0, 2.1], p 6.1e-05) and +1.70 pp over the raw sealed labels (17 saves, 0 harms, CI90 [1.1, 2.3], p 1.5e-05), non-negative on OLD500 and NEW500 in both, and not one gold-scenario stratum harmed on intent anywhere in either. The promote branch is the entire difference: 19 of the 39 changed rows, 15 of them landing on the gold intent, against 2 of 39 for v1's edit distance. Two honest caveats: the whole intent gain is ONE stratum -- recommendation, 46.67 to 71.67 on 60 rows, with 17 of 18 strata flat against v1 -- and the multi-owner half of the tie-break never fires on this roster, so it is exercised only by unit tests. This is still a repair of the baseline's own output rather than a mechanism: the points belong to the comparator, and every pending SLURP cell now has to beat 73.10.
